requirements.requirement: weekly; ≥3 years and current ICE Cotton No. 2 COT observation
requirements.policy: CFTC public API; exact COTTON NO. 2 futures-only disaggregated contract

requirements.requirement: weekly current lawful BAL and other listed cotton-vehicle notes/shares, AUM and observable flows
requirements.policy: issuer/sponsor primary data only; if lawful history is unavailable mark manual or unavailable, never infer flows from price

requirements.requirement: monthly; ≥30 years of dated ONI history
requirements.policy: NOAA CPC observed ONI only; it cannot substitute for regional crop weather

requirements.requirement: daily; ≥3 years for cotton/USD regimes
requirements.policy: reuse one Federal Reserve/FRED semantic series; no commodity-specific clone

requirements.requirement: monthly; ≥10 years with release vintage
requirements.policy: primary global industrial-production/trade series; licensed PMI remains contextual

requirements.requirement: daily; ≥3 years of producer/importer INR/BRL/CNY against USD
requirements.policy: primary central-bank or lawful market history with exact bases and roles

requirements.requirement: current front-month ICE Cotton No. 2 quote
requirements.policy: reuse swarm pulse quote transport (`@CT.1`); label US¢/lb futures

requirements.requirement: point-in-time ICE Cotton No. 2 close history with source identity
requirements.policy: reuse lawful shared market history for `@CT.1`; continuous back-adjusted futures

requirements.requirement: point-in-time WTI history aligned to cotton
requirements.policy: reuse lawful `@CL.1` history; crude/polyester is one substitution confirmation

requirements.requirement: current old/new-crop settlements with ≥3 years of curve snapshots
requirements.policy: lawful ICE settlements with exact contracts; otherwise unavailable

requirements.requirement: current ICE-Cotlook A-China basis aligned by grade/unit/FX
requirements.policy: lawful Cotlook/exchange/primary quotations; licensed data remains manual or unavailable

requirements.requirement: current ICE Cotton No. 2 delivery notices and load-out pressure by certified location
requirements.policy: lawful ICE delivery/warehouse reports with contract and report date; otherwise unavailable

requirements.requirement: current ICE certified cotton stocks by grade and location
requirements.policy: lawful ICE warehouse reports; preserve revisions and do not infer non-certified inventory

requirements.requirement: monthly; ≥10 years of world balance and stocks-to-use with China reserve separated
requirements.policy: USDA official cotton balance with release vintage and revisions

requirements.requirement: weekly; ≥5 market years of US upland and Pima sales, reductions/adjustments and shipments by destination
requirements.policy: USDA FAS primary data; keep upland and Pima identified and separate gross sales, net sales and physical shipment

requirements.requirement: monthly current physical mill use by major consuming country
requirements.policy: USDA, ICAC and national primary data; orders, exports and polyester prices cannot substitute for realised mill consumption

requirements.requirement: current plus ≥30 years of yield-weighted weather aligned to planting, squaring, boll and harvest stages
requirements.policy: primary meteorological observations/forecasts with geography, run time and expiry

requirements.requirement: weekly; ≥10 years of regional planting, condition, boll and harvest progress with current observation
requirements.policy: USDA/national primary crop-progress reports aligned by region and crop year; weather cannot substitute

requirements.requirement: current area, abandonment, yield and output by major origin with dispersion
requirements.policy: USDA/India/China/Brazil primary releases; do not duplicate balance production

requirements.requirement: current dated China reserve/import policy, farm support, restrictions and verified rerouting
requirements.policy: primary regulator/government/customs evidence with effective date and expiry

requirements.requirement: current marginal farm cost and polyester-substitution range
requirements.policy: primary farm budgets and lawful polyester/energy/FX inputs; separate observed price, model range and market expectation
